cm-analyst.description: Evidence-backed analysis: options, root cause, comparisons, plans. Use for a judgment question with a clear scope. Default analyst grade. Final text is the report deliverable; no file edits.

cm-analyst-strong.description: Evidence-backed analysis for ambiguous, cross-cutting or high-stakes questions. Only when you cannot write an exact spec or an error is costly; several times the cost. Final text is the report deliverable; no file edits.

cm-designer.description: UI/UX, TUI layout and docs structure checked against the project's UX guidelines. Use for interface work. Report in final text only; no file edits.

cm-explorer.description: Reconnaissance: find, read and summarize; answer factual questions with cited paths. Use when the answer is facts, not judgment. Read-only; fan-out friendly; cheap.

cm-implementer.description: Normal bounded implementation. Default implementer grade. Worktree-isolated; reports changed files, validation and the worktree state.

cm-implementer-light.description: Fully specified edits: exact files, exact change, a check that gates it. Mechanical, repetitive, well-scoped work: exact spec and a gating check; cheapest. Worktree-isolated.

cm-implementer-strong.description: Implementation needing design judgment. Only when you cannot write an exact spec or an error is costly; several times the cost. Worktree-isolated.

cm-lead.description: Lead: owns integration and final synthesis; routes work by function, then grade; delegates bounded work and does small work itself.

cm-reviewer.description: Independent report-only review: verified BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR/NIT findings and an APPROVE or REVISE verdict. Default reviewer; choose per the review routing table. Read-only.

cm-reviewer-strong.description: Independent report-only review, same contract, for high-stakes changes and strong or lead authors (see the review routing table); several times the cost of cm-reviewer. Read-only.
